title: Examples of $\mathbb{Z}/2$-Harmonic 1-Forms
summary: In this paper, we develop methods for constructing $\mathbb{Z}/2$-harmonic 1-forms in dimension three by varying the background metric. On $\mathbb{R}^3$, we construct an example for which the complement of the smooth locus in the singular set is a Cantor set. We realize every finite graph with positive even valence at each vertex as the monodromy locus of a $\mathbb{Z}/2$-harmonic 1-form on $B^3$.
